Internal helper: the advance widths a table's font is measured in

Source: R/tables.R
dot-jst_docx_font_widths.Rd

Times New Roman's for that face and the faces that share its metrics (Times, Liberation Serif, Tinos), and for no font named (NULL: the measure until Session 407); Arial's for Arial, Helvetica, Liberation Sans and Arimo; Calibri's for Calibri and Carlito; for any other font the generous table. The name is compared without regard to case or outer spaces. The unknown-character width rides as the attribute "other": half an em in Times, as before, and each face's digit width elsewhere.

Usage

.jst_docx_font_widths(font = NULL)

Arguments

font

Character(1), or NULL.

Value

A named numeric vector, in thousandths of an em.
